author: B. P. Huynh
title: City of Eagle seeks applicant for Design Review Board position
text:
The City of Eagle announced on May 13 that it is seeking to fill one position on its Design Review Board.
The opening is intended for a resident with experience in construction management, architecture, or design. The city said the board meets regularly on the second and fourth Thursday of each month at 6:00 p.m., and that this is a volunteer role appointed by recommendation from the Mayor and approval by the City Council.
According to the announcement, applicants must be residents of Eagle. The city said interested individuals are required to complete a Request for Consideration Application and are encouraged to submit a resume or curriculum vitae. The position will remain open until filled.
“We are in search of a qualified person with a background in construction management or architecture and/or design. Must be a resident of Eagle,” the city said in its statement.
The application process is ongoing, with no set deadline for submission. Further details about how to apply can be found through resources provided by the City of Eagle.
